questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: SU er et anerkendt universitet der tilbyder mange spændende fag. Jeg kunne derfor vælge fag der mindede om de valgfag KU tilbyder. Derudover valgte jeg SU fordi jeg tænkte at det kunne være relevant i forhold til fremtidig karriere muligheder.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. SU sendte en masse information mails ud både inden og under opholdet.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der stod tutorer i lufthavnen og på universitetet som hjalp med det praktiske når man lige var landet.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Det var VIRKELIG VIRKELIG svært at finde et sted at bo, hvis ikke man blev tilbudt housing af SU. Jeg fik desværre ikke tilbudt et kollegieværelse af SU og måtte derfor selv ud og lede.
Stockholms boligmarked er virkelig forfærdeligt, især når man kun søger en lejlighed at leje i 5 måneder. Derudover er det helt vildt dyrt. Jeg endte med at bo på hotel i 1 måned før jeg fandt en nogenlunde lejlighed. Det var virkelig en forfærdelig oplevelse at søge en bolig i Stockholm og der var hverken hjælp at hente hos SU eller KU.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Der er helt vildt mange der bliver snydt. Jeg søgte blandt andet bolig ved at slå opslag op i diverse Facebook grupper og jeg blev kontaktet utallige gange af folk der forsøgte at snyde mig. Har mødt andre der havde samme oplevelse.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: De sendte en mail ud hvor de step by step forklarede hvordan man søgte fag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: SU's Office of International Affairs

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik begge mine første prioriteter. En uge inden studiestart fik jeg lov til at skifte mit første fag, hvilket var meget fedt! De er super fleksible og hjælpsomme

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: De har først til mølle princip, så det er om at sidde klar på hjemmesiden den dag der åbnes op for registrering.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg havde kandidat-fag selvom jeg er bachelor studerende. I nogle fag var niveauet ret højt, mens andre fag var meget chill

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: SU er ikke ligeså strukturerede som KU, og de er meget last minute på nogle punkter. Der var en masse tvivl vedr. eksamener, essays m.v. Men det hele endte med at gå godt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Legal English.
EU Competition Law.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Vælg Legal English! Det er super chill og en god start på udvekslingen. Man får massere af tid til at opleve byen, møde nye mennesker og have det sjovt. 
EU Competition law var også meget spændende. Marios er en virkelig god underviser! Vi var på diverse studiebesøg og besøgte blandt andet forskellige advokatkontorer.

questions.answer: At bo på hotel den første måned. Det var ret dyrt.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: At handle mad i supermarkeder var dyrere end forventet.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Den juridiske studenterforening på SU var tutorer for os de første 2 måneder De arrangerede en masse socialt og det var en meget god måde at møde de svenske studerende.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Besøg de forskellige øer.
Besøg museerne (der er et par som er gratis)

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
De studerende arrangerer weekendture hvor man tager færgen fra Stockholm til fx. Helsinki og Tallinn. Typisk ender det med at 100-200 studerende er afsted. Det er ret billigt og mega fedt. 
Derudover kan jeg virkelig anbefale at tage til det svenske Lapland. 
Jeg kan også anbefale at tage weekendture til andre byer i Sverige.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt da svenskere minder meget om danskere.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Deltag i den juridiske studenterforenings aktiviteter.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: svenskere kan være ret reserverede

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At det mindede om den danske kultur.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Søg bolig gennem SU, men hvis du ligesom mig er uheldig og ikke får tilbudt noget, så start i god tid med at søge. Gå i stedet for at tage offentlig transport (i centrum altså, -det er en smuk by). Se en Ishockey kamp live.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det er en dyr by, så ens SU er ikke nok. (i hvert fald ikke for mig)

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de skønne mennesker jeg mødte

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At snakke engelsk 24/7

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Jeg kan virkelig anbefale at tage til Stockholm. Selvom det 'bare' er Sverige, så har det helt vildt meget at byde på.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
